steps.cap: One AI chip is not enough to train a model. So 72 of them are wired together in one rack, a cabinet the size of a wardrobe, and run as one computer.
Inside the rack, copper wires link each tray of chips to the switch trays, which pass data between any two chips. Copper carries a signal only a few meters.
Training a large model takes many racks, too far apart for copper. The links between racks carry the signal as flashes of light in glass fiber.
At each end of a fiber, a laser turns the electrical signal into flashes of light, and a detector turns them back. That lets thousands of chips in many racks work on one model.
